claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile with N=sum_i r_i, q=N+1, alpha=N+2, C=(1+2z) product_i((1+z)^r_i+z), d=z(1+z)^q, P=C+d, and x the first strict descent of P under zero-extended coefficients, for every p satisfying x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, and 2p<=alpha, j=p-2 has d[j+1]C[j]-d[j]C[j+1]>0. Thus d[j]/C[j] and d[j]/(C[j]+d[j]) strictly increase from j to j+1.
claims.scope: Universal informal root-mixture lemma only on actual first-descent eligible lower-half ranks. The 3p guard is retained though unused in the proof. No deletion, selector, MASS, or payment conclusion follows.
claims.reason: The first-descent and binomial-rise argument gives Delta_x C<0; log-concavity and positive support propagate Delta_j C<0; the exact signed-minor identity then has a strictly positive first term and a nonnegative second contribution. The probability map preserves strict order. Informal proof only.

claims.statement: For profile (a2,a3,a4)=(10,0,0), N=20, n=33, alpha=22 and first strict descent x=11, the unrestricted minor at k=4 is -3549105 with (d[4],d[5],C[4],C[5])=(1330,5985,27315,125586). At p=6 the current-p endpoint and each represented arity-2 tip strict flag are zero, but x+2<=p fails.
claims.scope: Exact finite counterexample to unrestricted/all-rank root-mixture monotonicity only. It is outside actual first-descent eligibility and does not refute the guarded lemma or primary payment.
claims.reason: Independent exact convolution and binomial arithmetic reproduce every displayed coefficient, minor, first descent, selector difference, and guard check; the required first-descent guard fails.

limitations: The eligible root-mixture lemma is informal and has no governed formal award.
Finite profile checks are bounded evidence, not proof of a universal claim.
No guarded deletion comparison, selector consequence, selected MASS, or primary payment is proved.
